w:r.w:t: ISO 15118 is an international standard that defines the communication interface between an Electric Vehicle (EV) and Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) — commonly known as a charging station. It is officially titled
"Road Vehicles — Vehicle to Grid Communication Interface"
and is developed by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

The standard goes far beyond simple plug-and-charge detection. It establishes a full bidirectional digital communication protocol — referred to as Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) communication — enabling EVs and charging infrastructure to exchange rich data in real time.
